question_text: Explain the three-way handshake in TCP.
reference_answer: TCP uses a three-way handshake to establish a reliable connection. First, the client sends a SYN segment to the server. The server responds with a SYN-ACK segment. Finally, the client sends an ACK segment to confirm the connection. This process ensures both sides are synchronized and ready to transmit data.
rubric: 1 mark for naming the three-way handshake. 1 mark for SYN step. 1 mark for SYN-ACK step. 1 mark for purpose (reliable connection / synchronization).
